summary: The audited site is served over HTTPS but lacks all recommended security headers, exposing it to a range of attacks such as XSS, clickjacking, MIME‑sniffing, and information leakage. No cookies are set, so cookie‑flag issues are not present, and no forms were detected, eliminating CSRF concerns. The missing headers significantly weaken the site’s security posture.

audit_report.summary: The audited site is served over HTTPS but lacks all recommended security headers, exposing it to a range of attacks such as XSS, clickjacking, MIME‑sniffing, and information leakage. No cookies are set, so cookie‑flag issues are not present, and no forms were detected, eliminating CSRF concerns. The missing headers significantly weaken the site’s security posture.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
findings.description: The response does not include a Content‑Security‑Policy (CSP) header, allowing arbitrary scripts to execute and enabling XSS attacks.
findings.remediation: Add a CSP header that restricts script sources, e.g., `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://trusted.cdn.com; object-src 'none';`

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
findings.description: The site does not send an HSTS header, allowing downgrade attacks and man‑in‑the‑middle interception.
findings.remediation: Add `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` to enforce HTTPS

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The site can be framed by other domains, making it vulnerable to clickjacking.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Without this header, browsers may MIME‑sniff content, potentially executing unintended scripts.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The absence of a Referrer-Policy header may leak referrer information to third parties.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: No Permissions-Policy header means the site cannot restrict use of APIs like geolocation, camera, etc., potentially exposing user data.
findings.remediation: Add `Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=()` to restrict APIs
